# Charred Marksman

Internal ID: Charred_Archer | Faction: Demon | Main biome: Ashlands | Abilities: Bow (2s), Bow volley (4s) | Trophy: Marksman trophy | Weak to (x1.5): Spirit | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Stagger | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce | Very resistant to (x0.25): Fire | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe | Stagger limit: 50%

# Introduction

Charred Marksman are hostile ranged enemies found in the Ashlands.

## Spawning

• Type: Middle of the Ashlands during the daytime | Limit: 3 | Frequency: Common | Stars: Yes

• Type: Middle of the Ashlands during the nighttime, despawn at dawn | Limit: none | Frequency: Common | Stars: Yes

• Type: Randomly from Monument of Torment (Elite) when a player is nearby | Limit: none | Frequency: Uncommon | Stars: Yes (2 stars only)

• Type: Randomly from Effigy of Malice inside Charred Fortress when a player is nearby | Limit: none | Frequency: Uncommon | Stars: Yes

• Type: Anywhere in the Meadows, Black Forests, Swamp, Mountains or Plains during the nighttime after defeating Fader, despawn at dawn | Limit: 3 | Frequency: Very rare | Stars: No

• Type: During "The undead army marches." before defeating Fader | Limit: 3 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

## Drops

• Item: Charred bone | 0 Star: 1-2 | 1 Star: 2-4 | 2 Star: 4-8

• Item: Marksman trophy | 0 Star: 5% | 1 Star: 5% | 2 Star: 5%

### Bow

Nocks an arrow and shoots the player (90 Pierce damage). This attack has a 2-second cooldown and can be used within 20 meters of a player. The arrow has an initial velocity of 40 meters per second and can travel for up to 4 seconds before disappearing. It has a spread of 2–20 degrees. This attack has a random spread of up to 2 degrees.

### Bow volley

Aims 25 degrees upward before drawing back and shooting a volley of ten arrows in the direction of the player (60 Pierce damage each). This attack has a 4-second cooldown and can be used when between 20–100 meters of a player. Each arrow has a random initial velocity between 20–40 meters per second and can travel for up to 4 seconds before disappearing. This attack has a random spread of up to 12 degrees for each projectile.

Categorias: Creatures
